title: Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod without -TimeoutSec can hang operations
description: Flags outbound HTTP calls in PowerShell that omit -TimeoutSec. Without an explicit timeout, network stalls, DNS issues, or unreachable endpoints can block for a long period and freeze UI flows, scheduled jobs, or pipeline stages.
detection_method: Regex scan for Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod calls without -TimeoutSec on the call line and no nearby timeout guard
preventionRule: All outbound web calls must define a finite -TimeoutSec value and include catch logging/fallback behavior for timeout failures.
remedy:
# BEFORE
$resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Method Get

# AFTER
$resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15
